general_information.Description: The Graduation Thesis (Business Plan) is an integrative experience that brings together various components of the undergraduate business studies in a more applied setting and under a new perspective. It enables students to further their knowledge and skills in conducting real business and apply creative ideas related to business field which they have found to be especially interesting or beneficial to them. As part of the course, students will learn about all aspects of the business plan and gain an understanding of standards and expectations needed to successfully complete writing and pitching for a business plan. This graduate business plan will be completed by a group of 4-6 students; however, each student will defend the business plan individually in front of an evaluation committee. Each group of students will be supported by a supervisor, who will provide them with essential guidance in conducting a market research, business plan components, deploying creative ideas and writing a business plan in a formal format and defending their arguments in front of the examination board. The business plan's topic is concerned with such areas as (1) project background (2) market analysis, (3) value proposition (4) key activity plan, (5) financial analysis, (6) Risk analysis and future roadmap.
general_information.StudentTasks: (1)Choose the project within the selected concentration (2)Divide and schedule work (3)Attend at least 80% of scheduled meetings with their supervisor(s) to be eligible for the thesis or capstone defense (4)Produce document and product according to project requirement (5)Defense individually work in front of examination board

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate an ability to integrate knowledge and handle complexity, and to plan and carry out advanced tasks independently and as a group member, within specified time limits
Use appropriate market research methodology to identify market problems, potential demands and to suggest suitable and more sustainable solutions to real business

Develop more critical thinking, creative thinking, operation and management capapility and a capability of analyzing management, marketing and financial aspects both theoretically and practically for business project

Write, present and defend the thesis fulfilling well-defined academic criteria and correctly referencing relevant business market research and other materials, which reflect the student’s academic and non-academic development throughout the whole process
Support for real business operation activity or develop feasible start-up plan for entrepreneurship

assessments.Duration: According to deadlines by the Academics Department
assessments.No Question: One piece of written work of no more than 100 pages
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Combination of all relevant acquired knowledge, quality of market data, creative idea, market feasibility, operation and management feasibility, logical and clear marketing activities aligh with KPIs and Objectives, financial aspects, written skills…
assessments.Grading Guide: Evaluation is based on the format, presentation of data, insightful analysis & practical recommendations for the project
assessments.Note: 30% of the whole Thesis Final Written thesis submitted before deadline.

assessments.Grading Guide: • Based on the schedule in the syllabus, each group report will be evaluated by the group supervisor. This evaluation is called progress assessment. • Individual mark for each progress assessment report is decided by the group supervisor and is assessed on the basis of the actual contribution by that individual to the group report. The individual mark can be lower or higher than the group mark and is in the range from 0% to 120% of the group mark where the average score of group members cannot be more than group mark.
